조도센서로 자동 조명: Automatic lighting with a light sensor
LDR 전압 분배기를 A1(PA1)에 연결하고, 어두워질수록 D6(PB1: Connect an LDR voltage divider to A1 (PA1) and build a night light in which the LED on D6 (PB10) gets brighter through PWM as it gets darker.
LDR(빛에 따라 저항이 바뀌는 소자)과 고정 저항으로 전압 분배기를 만: Build a voltage divider from an LDR (a part whose resistance changes with light) and a fixed resistor
밝을수록 A1 전압이 낮아지는 이유를 계산한다: Calculate why the A1 voltage drops as it gets brighter
문턱값(데드존)과 비례 제어로 PWM 듀티를 정한다: Set the PWM duty with a threshold (dead zone) and proportional control
**가변저항 ADC → 시리얼 출력**, **PWM으로 LED 밝기·숨쉬: **Potentiometer ADC → serial output**, **LED brightness and breathing with PWM**.
**전압 분배기**: V(A1) = 3.3 V × R_LDR / (10: **Voltage divider**: V(A1) = 3.3 V × R_LDR / (10 kΩ + R_LDR).
LDR은 밝으면 저항이 작고(수백 Ω–1 kΩ), 어두우면 커집니다(수십: An LDR has a low resistance in bright light (a few hundred Ω–1 kΩ) and a high one in the dark (tens to hundreds of kΩ).
- 어두움(R_LDR ≈ 30 kΩ 이상): V ≈ 2.5 V 이상 →: - Dark (R_LDR ≈ 30 kΩ or more): V ≈ 2.5 V or more → ADC ≈ 3100 or more
LDR은 방향이 없지만, 검사는 1번 핀이 A1 쪽이기를 기대합니다. 핀: An LDR has no direction, but the check expects pin 1 on the A1 side. Hover over a pin to see its number.
LED를 **D6** (PB10, TIM2_CH3)에 연결하세요. 펌웨어: Connect the LED to **D6** (PB10, TIM2_CH3). The firmware sets its brightness with a 1 kHz PWM.
**▶ 실행**하고 LDR의 **조도(lux)** 슬라이더(속성 창)나: Press **▶ Run** and change the light with the LDR's **illuminance (lux)** slider (in the properties panel) or by dragging over the LDR. As it gets darker, the LED gets brighter and the console prints something like `light 3100 -> LED 100%`.
Grading changes the illuminance from 1000 lux (bright) to 2 lux (dark).
문턱 근처에서 LED가 깜빡거린다면 **히스테리시스**(켤 때와 끌 때의: If the LED flickers near the threshold, you need **hysteresis** (different thresholds for turning on and turning off).
light 값이 2000 이상 변함: The light value changes by 2000 or more
밝을 때 LED 듀티 2 % 이하: LED duty 2 % or less when bright
어두울 때 LED 듀티 90 % 이상: LED duty 90 % or more when dark
LED가 꺼졌다가 밝게 켜짐: The LED goes from off to brightly on
LDR과 고정 저항의 위치를 바꿈 — 밝을수록 LED가 켜지는 반대 동작: Swapping the LDR and the fixed resistor — you get the opposite behavior, with the LED turning on as it gets brighter.
고정 저항 없이 LDR만 A1–GND에 연결 — 분배기가 아니라서 A1이: Connecting only the LDR between A1 and GND, without the fixed resistor — it is not a divider, so A1 floats.
문턱 1200/3000을 조정해 형광등(약 300 lux)에서는 꺼지고: Adjust the 1200/3000 thresholds so the light stays off under fluorescent lighting (about 300 lux) and turns on at dusk (about 10 lux).
Turn it into an on/off (ON/OFF) night light with hysteresis.
